title: Programs
intro: The plan as a tree on a timeline: work streams, their programs and the projects in each program. A work stream's or program's bar is the span its projects cover, and the counts beside it add up the flags raised on those projects. Open a program to see its projects. Everyone can read it.
emptyHint: Work streams, programs and projects are created on the Plan page and appear here.
barCriticalInside: holds a project on the critical path

announce.expandedAll: Every work stream and program expanded
announce.collapsedAll: Every work stream and program collapsed

critical.intro: The projects upstream of {{name}}, from the plan's dates; those with no slack drive its end. Projects in a folded row or outside the program pick are listed too.
